name: Portals of the Legion
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Behold - the Hand of Iruxos. A gruesome sight indeed.

You must possess it if the demon portals at Mannoroc Coven are to be banished... which is what I now ask you to do. The Demon threat is increasing and we must close these portals to stem the tide of demons to this world. Good luck, adventurer... and be wary of the portal guardians.
narrative.objectives: Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven and return to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: You are to be commended, adventurer. Your effort has helped greatly in fighting the demon threat, and all of Azeroth is safer because of it.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you banished the demon portals at Mannoroc Coven?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 38, 6,400 XP in all.

quests.name: Hand of Iruxos
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the Demon Box from Thunder Axe Fortress, and return it, along with the Demon Pick to Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village.
